measurement_note: Size is N = S + T, the combined source and target length. Across the tiers, target length grows from 2 to 10 while the source contains an equal supply of every distinct target letter. Two frequency passes take O(S + T) time. Correctly recounting the complete source and target from scratch for each target position completes all tiers and fails through O(T(S + T)) scaling.
